rules.rule: The plan file is the summary table plus item sections only; no assumptions, open questions, risks
must: Every plan is one Markdown file with two parts — and only those two
No assumptions preamble, no open-questions section, no risks or rollout matrix

rules.rule: Never add work the brief did not raise; name suggestions in the reply
must: adding work nobody raised
is not, however sensible it looks
name them in the reply, one line each

rules.rule: An open point that changes what an item does is asked before writing, not guessed or left as a leave-out
must: Settle what the brief left open before writing, not inside the file
listing such a point as a leave-out and writing anyway is the guess this step forbids

rules.rule: Y only on repo evidence; a claim is not evidence; unverified stays N and is reported
must: Evidence is what the repo shows
nothing is marked `Y` on someone's say-so
stays `N` and is named in the report as unverified

rules.rule: Part-done is N; every acceptance criterion must settle for Y
must: Part-done stays `N` — there is no half status
`Y` needs every criterion settled in the repo

rules.rule: Update never renumbers or drops items; new work is appended with fresh numbers
must: never renumber or drop items
Never renumber\s+anything else to slot one into the middle

rules.rule: A rejected item keeps its section, tagged X with a one-line reason; never deleted
must: A rejected\s+item keeps `\[ \]`, is tagged `X`, and states why in one line — never delete it

rules.rule: Closing item last; deleting the plan file only after asking, never unasked
must: The last item is always the closing one
ask the user whether to delete this file
never delete unasked

rules.rule: Existing file at the target path: say so and ask before overwriting
must: If something is already there, say so and ask before overwriting

rules.rule: After writing, report path plus counts in the fixed shape; never paste the plan back
must: `wrote tmp/sso-plan\.md — 0 Y / 5 N / 0 X`
never paste the plan back
